cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(native_ui LANGUAGES CXX)
add_library(native_ui_layout STATIC src/layout.cpp src/tree_layout.cpp)
add_library(native_ui::layout ALIAS native_ui_layout)
add_library(native_ui_update STATIC src/update.cpp)
target_include_directories(native_ui_update PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(native_ui_update PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
add_library(native_ui::update ALIAS native_ui_update)
if(WIN32)
  add_library(native_ui_win32 STATIC src/win32_host.cpp)
  target_include_directories(native_ui_win32 PUBLIC include)
  target_compile_features(native_ui_win32 PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_link_libraries(native_ui_win32 PUBLIC native_ui::layout native_ui::update user32 gdi32)
  add_library(native_ui::win32 ALIAS native_ui_win32)
endif()
target_include_directories(native_ui_layout PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(native_ui_layout PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
